findings.evidence: `Orientation.lean:366` declares `reorientPreprojectiveAlgebraEquiv : preprojectiveAlgebra k (Reorient Q σ) ≃ₐ[k] preprojectiveAlgebra k Q`; no second arbitrary quiver or underlying-graph identification occurs in its statement.
findings.fix: Scope these passages to the explicit `Q`/`Reorient Q σ` construction, or add the stated general interface carrying an identification of the underlying graphs.
findings.issue: The module notes claim the new module proves a cross-quiver theorem for any two quivers with a common underlying graph, but the exported equivalence only compares `Q` with `Reorient Q σ`; the same overclaim appears in `Reorient.lean` lines 16–17 and `Orientation.lean` lines 91–95.

summary: The documentation overstates the scope of the orientation-independence API: it handles a quiver and its explicit `Reorient`, not arbitrary quivers equipped only with a common underlying graph.
